description: This is a Swift source file defining the VoiceSessionCoordinator class responsible for managing voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, sending, and dismissing voice sessions within an application. It coordinates interactions with overlay controllers and a voice forwarder, and maintains session state.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages voice recognition sessions, handling their lifecycle and interactions with overlays and forwarding mechanisms.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice session with specified source, text, and optional attributed text; returns a unique token identifying the session.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the ongoing session with partial transcribed text and optional attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the session with complete text, sends chime, and optionally auto-sends after a delay; updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Immediately sends the current session's transcript and begins forwarding, or dismisses if the transcript is empty.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session with a specified reason and outcome, cleaning up session state.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the input level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current session's token, text, and visibility status.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles overlay dismissal events, clearing session state and refreshing runtime.
